Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
We’re Siemens, a collection of great minds who are all making the future. You could be one of us!
Siemens is a global technology powerhouse that owns innovative solutions in the areas of electrification, automation and digitalization. Software and R&D play a crucial role at Siemens. The R&D division in Brasov, Cluj-Napoca, and Bucharest is the competence center for research, software development, IT and engineering, which makes the company a major leader in vertical IT technologies.
This role is situated in the strategic area of Sales Platforms. You will be working on driving and scaling innovative digital commerce ecosystems, including SiePortal. SiePortal is Siemens’ comprehensive, unified B2B platform that combines the functionalities of the Industry Mall and Siemens Industry Online Support (SIOS) under one roof, optimizing product discovery, configuration, purchasing, and digital workflow support for our global industrial customer base.
 About The Role
 We're looking for a mid-level DevOps Engineer with hands-on Azure experience to help build and maintain our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. You'll work with development and QA teams to improve deployment process and increase system reliability.
 Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (or GitHub Actions/Jenkins)
Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure (VMs, AKS, App Services, Storage, Networking)
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Pulumi)
Monitor system performance and reliability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights
Automate deployment, scaling, and configuration management processes
Collaborate with development teams to streamline release processes
Manage containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS)
Maintain security best practices, including IAM/RBAC, secrets management (Azure Key Vault), and network security
Troubleshoot production issues and participate in on-call rotation
Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbooks
 Required Qualifications
2–4 years of experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure role
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (compute, networking, storage, identity)
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates)
Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins)
Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/AKS)
Scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python
Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana, Prometheus)
Understanding of networking concepts (VNets, load balancers, DNS, firewalls)
Experience with version control (Git)
 Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
